courseTitle: Diploma in Hearing Language and Speech (DHLS)
heroHeadline: Understand Hearing. Discover Speech. Empower Communication.
heroSupporting: Explore the Diploma in Hearing Language and Speech (DHLS) and discover how communication, language and hearing come together.
description: An offline, regular 1-year diploma course recognised by the Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI). The curriculum explores the scientific mechanisms of speech organs, linguistic articulation, acoustic soundwaves, audiology, and community rehabilitation.
